cliLaunchQualification.proofScope: Pinned official source and identical local parser bytes only; no runtime, configuration or full installation verification.

providers.capability: Future Codex-backed inference through Hermes and bounded Roost MCP/API
providers.boundary: No independent task, memory, kanban, schedule, delegation or session authority. No Roost credentials in provider/model environment; no direct database or arbitrary filesystem access.
providers.updateRollback: No automatic install/update. Private pinned environment, retained prior environment/config, license/dependency review and repeated compatibility PoC for every pin change.
providers.healthReadiness: Contract v5 adds Worker-sealed startup input with no model bootstrap tools. The separately verified read-only broker is reserved for future runtime reads. Native Hermes isolation, live compatibility and budget/stop/recovery remain unproven. Hermes task execution stays blocked; observer never starts a broker.
providers.resourceCost: Python >=3.11,<3.14 plus dependencies, local provider process and model usage. Disk, memory, latency and token overhead unmeasured; measure in read-only PoC before any pilot.
providers.failureMode: Expected not-ready state without incidents, installation, claim or automatic fallback. Only an explicitly configured, integrity-checked version probe can start. Worker/API task admission fails closed.

hostLifecycle.proofScope: Pre-execution denial of current uncontained providers. Docker health and owner maintenance decisions cannot admit agent execution.
